Takaie Kanigumo.name: Takaie Kanigumo
Takaie Kanigumo.basicInfo:
Takaie Kanigumo is a Paranormal Liberation Front adviser from the Brown regiment, carrying the Meta Liberation movement's ideology into the merged organization. A spider-traited heteromorph, he treats the movement as an answer to exclusion and directs that anger toward its enemies. His advisory position gives him a role among the rank and file rather than placing him above the Front's principal leaders. He has two spider legs extending from his back, double rows of spider teeth over his mouth, six wavy green markings across his scalp and a scar on the left side of his head. He wears a long black shirt with a large yellow fur collar and a black face covering.
Speaking Style: Rough, forceful appeals that turn shared grievance into a demand for collective action.
Combat Role: Armed movement organizer and close-range threat supported by his heteromorphic anatomy. His appearance does not establish web production, venom or mind control.
Under Pressure: Appeals to the group's anger and solidarity, grows hostile toward compromise and expects others to prove their allegiance through action.
Takaie Kanigumo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He seeks recognition for people denied dignity while endorsing violence that denies other people the same protection.
Motivation: Advance liberation ideology and obtain power for heteromorphs through the Front's struggle.
Concealment: His language of collective purpose leaves little room for heteromorphs who reject his chosen methods. Shared anatomy does not give him authority over their choices.
Leverage: A crowd's willingness to listen gives him influence; calm refusal from people with similar experiences can expose the limits of his claim to speak for everyone.
Connections: The former Meta Liberation Army, the Front's Brown regiment and its leadership. Spinner may become a rallying figure after the organization's position changes.
Knowledge: Liberation rhetoric, Front organization and resentment associated with heteromorph discrimination. His anatomy and ideological behavior are described in
Canon voice & behavior: Uses emphatic public appeals and dismisses peaceful alternatives as inadequate to the suffering he invokes.
Thread: If he helps rally a hospital assault, will the crowd follow his demand for violence or listen to heteromorph heroes offering another course?
QUIRK: An unnamed arthropod mutation; the visible spider traits do not establish a separate ranged power.
personality: Ideological: Interprets conflict through liberation doctrine.
Agitating: Turns shared grievance into pressure for action.
Intolerant of compromise: Dismisses alternatives to the movement's violence.
Speaking style: Rough, fervent appeals addressed to a group.
abilities: Spider anatomy: Has two additional spider legs on his back and arthropod mouth structures.
Movement organization: Holds an advisory role within the Front's Brown regiment.
Agitation: Uses liberation rhetoric to encourage collective action.
Close-range threat: Can participate in a physical confrontation without an established web or venom ability.
Fighting style: Supports group action and presses ideological authority while advancing with other Front members.
Takaie Kanigumo.visualDescription: An adult heteromorph man of average height with two jointed spider legs projecting from his back. Double rows of spider teeth cover his mouth, partly concealed by a black face mask. Six wavy green markings run from his forehead across his scalp, and a scar marks the left side of his head. He wears a long black shirt with an oversized yellow fur collar. His stance is tense and confrontational.
